A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FantasyWorld work and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, references, and Appendices A.1-A.4. The additional page in v2 reflects layout reflow, not a material completeness gap.

before.justification: Sections 4.2-4.3 report original WorldScore comparisons, geometry-branch ablations, and RealEstate10K reconstruction results in Tables 1-2 and qualitative figures.

after.justification: v2 retains the original WorldScore evaluations, geometry-branch ablations, RealEstate10K reconstruction measurements, and qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices A.1-A.3 retain the same frozen Wan2.1 backbone, PCB/IRG architecture, bidirectional cross-attention, camera adapter, 3D DPT heads, and two-stage training objectives.

E1.justification: Both use RealEstate10K, ACID, DL3DV, WildRGB, ScanNet, and TartanAir for training. Evaluation retains the same WorldScore small/large camera-motion scenarios and RealEstate10K reconstruction task.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains WonderWorld, AETHER, Uni3C, and Voyager in both motion settings. The comparator membership in Figures 4-5 and the model/initialization variants in Table 2 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain 1,000 Small-motion WorldScore samples, 100 curated Large-motion cases, and 100 RealEstate10K samples. Metrics, training budgets, and baseline inference resolutions and frame counts are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix A.4.

E4.justification: The geometry-branch ablations, large-motion robustness evaluation, feature PCA analysis in Figure 3, and qualitative failure/reconstruction comparisons in Figures 4-5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same reporting of means and standard deviations across samples for consistency metrics. Neither version provides additional repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-2 and the qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, the full model with VGGT initialization retains PSNR 28.24, SSIM 0.86, and LPIPS 0.14 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The attention and update equations, temporal upsampling relation, and geometry-loss formulations in Section 3.4 and Appendices A.1-A.3 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims concerning unified video/3D modeling, cross-branch supervision, geometric consistency, and potentially reusable 3D features without per-scene optimization.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations of consistency gains and baseline failure modes. Section 5 preserves the fixed-length generation limitation and the proposed need for caching or streaming mechanisms for longer sequences.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A.1-A.4 retain identical implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, baseline repository links and commits, and inference settings. No technical or access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to VGGT, Voyager, Geometry Forcing, and other prior methods are unchanged. The reference list only reflows across pages.

P1.justification: v2 adds a first-page footnote explaining the existing author symbols for equal contribution, project leader, corresponding author, and internship attribution. The arXiv version/date stamp changes, while scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added footnote accompanies limited page reflow: Table 2 and Figures 5-6 shift vertically, Appendix A starts on page 14 instead of 13, and Appendix A.4 spills onto page 16. Figure designs, table structures, and captions are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new footnote clarifies author attribution, but the methods, evidence, claims, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. This administrative clarification and the accompanying layout reflow do not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
